tag_help_tooltip: Don't know how to use tags ? Click here
tag_help_text_1: Tags are useful to mark objects (experiments or resources) to quickly retrieve them later.
tag_help_text_2: In the lab a tag is composed of a key and a value. Think of the tag key as a category that can have different values. An object can have multiple tags which make tags more flexible than folders.
tag_help_example: Example : a tag key could be study and then you can create 2 tags with this key and a studies' name as value like study:omix and study:taxonomy. Then you can tag your experiment with one of theses tags. Next you can find all the experiments that are related to the study omix by filtering with the tag study:omix.
tag_help_hint_1: Hint : to quickly tag an object (a resource or an experiment), you can simply drag the corresponding tag from the sidebar to this object.
tag_help_hint_2: Hint : you can search by multiple tags.
empty_queue: There is no experiment in the execution queue
